sentences.ar: حرامي فات على بيت جحا بالليل.
sentences.en: A thief entered Juha's house at night.
He started searching in the dark.
Juha woke up and started searching with him.
The thief was afraid and said: what are you doing?
Juha said: I am helping you.
In the day I find nothing.
Maybe at night something will show up.
